# Commission Clause

Accrues commission at the configured basis-points rate on confirmed net order receipts, after reversals. A new payout reservation must be positive and no greater than commission accrued minus commission already paid and amounts still reserved. Opening a payout reserves part of the accrued obligation; it neither secures cash nor confirms payment.

Order capture and reversal observations update the commission target using completed less reversed amounts and the configured rounded basis-points rate. Attachment handling verifies the producing clause, matching prepared item, request correlation, initialized origin, active order and named-source readiness before using its payment totals.

On the manual payout path the ledger reconciles confirmed captures less reversals and may revise a previously closed payout. For an account-to-account payout it requires both matching settlement evidence and confirmed completion of the net transfer, with no unresolved requests, reservations or reversal. A successful account payout records the gross amount against commission paid and tracks the net transfer and fee separately. A qualifying rejected or returned account payout can release the reservation without recording a payment.

The inherited ledger initializes accrued, paid and reserved amounts to zero, with empty targets and settlements. It adds integer amounts in minor units. It neither compares the currencies of contributing documents nor converts between currencies.

Configuration references: `bindings.orders` defaults to `/orders`; `bindings.payouts` defaults to `/payouts`; `bindings.rate` defaults to `/terms/commissionBps`; `bindings.state` defaults to `/balance`.
